title: Make it Happen!
html:
Many people never change for the better or change their occupation to one that is interesting. Or exciting. Or change their standard of living, their incomes or health.

They go through life with great expectations for themselves. Thinking of everything they want to achieve, have, see, or experience. Then, wait forit tohappen. Either by luck, wishful thinking or hope.

Unfortunately, the reality is that nothinghappens unless youtake some action.

What is the easiest way to get ahead in life? There isn't one.

It is necessary totake the time to ask yourself what is important to you in your life? What significant changes would you like to seehappen?

I always put this off to the detriment of what I want in my life. Plan your life like you would a holiday. That is spend time onit. Regularly.

Once you know what you want. Mentally believe thatit willhappen in your mind's eye. Thenmake a commitment to seeit through thentake the first step.

Write on a piece of paper a statement like Bruce Lee did,

My Definite Chief Aim

I, Bruce Lee, will be the first highest paid Oriental super star in the United States. In return I will give the most exciting performances and render the best of quality in the capacity of an actor. Starting 1970 I will achieve world fame and from then onward till the end of 1980 I will have in my possession $10,000,000. I will live the way I please and achieve inner harmony and happiness.

Bruce Lee

Jan. 1969

Remember, success doesn't come at your convenience but at your inconvenience.

No one is going tomakeit for you; there is no one else, just you.

Ask yourself, What isit I really want tohappen in my life? Writeit down. Imagineit. Liveit in your mind. Then once you have decidedtake some immediate action tomakeithappen.
